sn_aia_agent_tool_m2m.description:
Purpose The ESG Response Generation tool is a specialized subflow designed to drive operational sustainability and corporate accountability. It automates the creation of high-quality email responses for complex enquiries, ensuring every interaction is handled with transparency, equity, and maximum resource efficiency.
Action & Logic
Trigger Condition: This tool is activated immediately upon the completion of the ESG data analysis and response synthesis phase, ensuring Governance through accurate and timely communication.
Data Integration: It synthesizes the generated email content with existing Work Notes to provide a transparent, contextual record of the response for responsible decision-making and oversight.
Record Linking: It utilizes the Case Sys ID to maintain a robust audit trail, programmatically linking the generated email response to the master record for seamless, accountable case management.
Inputs
Email Reply (email_reply): The generated response content required to address the enquiry, ensuring alignment with ESG standards and regulatory compliance.
Work Notes (work_notes): Critical history and technical context updated to reflect the response sent, maintaining service continuity for all stakeholders.
Case Sys ID (case_sys_id): The unique system identifier for the case, ensuring full auditability and record integrity throughout the lifecycle of the enquiry.
Key Output The tool facilitates the immediate generation and logging of an enquiry response, mitigating Governance risk by ensuring a standardized, compliant communication trail. It supports Social goals by providing stakeholders with prompt, reliable information and protects employee well-being by eliminating repetitive manual drafting.
sn_aia_agent_tool_m2m.name: Draft Email Response
